source: Earthdawn 4E Player's Guide + Deeper Secrets — Nethermancer spells. Mechanics + terse original-wording effect lines distilled from the rulebook; descriptions are player-facing paraphrases (copyright-safe, never verbatim prose). taxonomy effects[] are hand-enriched per docs/EFFECT-TAXONOMY.md (§3.4 sustained vs instantaneous).
notes: 123 Nethermancer spells, Circles 1-15. Mechanics (threads/weaving/casting/range/duration/area/effect) + Success Levels/Extra Threads for all; taxonomy effects[] enriched incrementally (combat/numeric spells first), rituals/summons carry a note effect.

description: per-spell player-facing prose (flavor + resolution + core mechanic), paraphrased from the rulebook extracts; SUMMARY remains the terse mechanic readout. No taxonomy impact — a catalog metadata field, not an effect.
threadCap: extra-thread cap by Circle band (rules data, not engine logic) — PLAN-SPELLS.md §3.1.
weavingDifficulty.reattune: on-the-fly matrix-swap difficulty, a POST-v1 mechanic carried in the shape now.
castingTarget is a HINT for the cast prompt; the test is always vs a NUMBER entered at cast time.

learning: spell-learning tables (PLAN-LEARN-SPELLS.md §4) — difficultyByCircle is an explicit {circle: difficulty} table (the engine reads a value, never computes circle+5), silverPerCircle is the suggested copy price (Circle × 100 sp, or whatever the tuition costs), and legendCostSource points at rules/legend.json costs.talentRank[circle].Novice — the Legend price is that ONE table, no duplicate.

Astral Spear.name: Astral Spear
Astral Spear.description: Weaves raw astral energy into a hurled spear of force; strikes the target's Mystic Defense; a successful cast deals its Effect step in damage.

Bone Circle.name: Bone Circle
Bone Circle.description: Inscribes a 2-yard circle of bones that invites a wandering spirit to dwell within, transforming it into a bone spirit. Cast against the spirit's Mystic Defense; the spirit guards the circle for Rank months.

Dark Messenger.name: Dark Messenger
Dark Messenger.description: Commands a nightflyer under the magician's control to carry a whispered message of up to twice his Spellcasting Rank in words. Cast against the creature's Mystic Defense; the flyer seeks out the recipient unerringly and speaks in the magician's voice.

effects.summary: Sends nightflyer to deliver a message

Dark Messenger.summary: Sends nightflyer to deliver a message

Ethereal Darkness.name: Ethereal Darkness
Ethereal Darkness.description: Pulls a splinter of otherworldly darkness to fill a 4-yard-radius sphere, extinguishing all light. Cast against the target's Mystic Defense; those inside suffer Full Darkness penalties to sight-based Action tests, while those versed in Nethermancy see normally.

Experience Death.name: Experience Death
Experience Death.description: Plunges the magician into a trance that replays a character's dying moments. Cast against the target's Mystic Defense; the Effect test grants temporary Damage Points, and damage first erodes those points before reaching his Current Damage.

Life Circle of One.name: Life Circle of One
Life Circle of One.description: Outlines a 4-yard-radius circle that repels undead, Horrors, and Horror constructs attempting to enter. Requires a Spellcasting (6) test, then a Spellcasting test against the entity's Mystic Defense, with the Effect test setting the damage dealt to the repelled entity.

Shadow Meld.name: Shadow Meld
Shadow Meld.description: Renders the target nearly invisible in shadows, granting +4 to all Stealthy Stride tests and letting Stealthy Stride function as a default skill. Cast against the target's Mystic Defense; ordinary light does not dispel it, and stepping back into shadow restores the effect.

effects.summary: +4 to Stealthy Stride tests while active.

Soul Armor.name: Soul Armor
Soul Armor.description: Draws jagged blue sigils that coalesce into a glimmering suit of chain mail, which sinks into the target and adds +3 to his Mystic Armor. Cast against the target's Mystic Defense.

effects.summary: +3 Mystic Armor while the spell is active.

Soulless Eyes.name: Soulless Eyes
Soulless Eyes.description: Gives the target's eyes a cruel, unsettling cast that adds +3 to all Intimidation tests for the duration. Cast against the target's Mystic Defense.

Spirit Dart.name: Spirit Dart
Spirit Dart.description: Hurls a dart of condensed astral energy at the target. Cast against the target's Mystic Defense; the Effect test sets the damage and the target's Mystic Armor drops by 2 until the end of the next round.

effects.summary: Reduces the target's Mystic Armor by 2 (on the target, not the caster).

Spirit Dart.summary: WIL + 2/Mystic and reduce Mystic Armor by 2

Spirit Grip.name: Spirit Grip
Spirit Grip.description: Taps the malevolent energy of the dead to harm a touched victim. Cast against the target's Mystic Defense; the Effect test determines damage and the target's Mystic and Physical Defenses drop by 2 until the end of the next round.

effects.summary: Reduces the target's Defenses by 2 (on the target, not the caster).

Detect Undead.name: Detect Undead
Detect Undead.description: Daubs the target's brow with dirt or ash to sense nearby undead. A successful Spellcasting (6) test reveals the number of undead within a 20-yard radius whose Mystic Defense the result equals or beats, though not their location or type.

Preserve.name: Preserve
Preserve.description: Holds inanimate matter in stasis so it cannot spoil or decay. Cast against the target's Mystic Defense (typically 6); everything within 2 yards is kept fresh, preserving cadavers for study and ingredients for Rank days.

Putrefy.name: Putrefy
Putrefy.description: Decomposes non-living organic matter at a glance, affecting up to 10 pounds of food or material. Cast against the highest Mystic Defense among those who might eat it (minimum 6); on a living target, recently consumed food putrefies instead and causes illness.

Spirit Labor.name: Spirit Labor
Spirit Labor.description: Summons swarming, multicolored points of light that perform menial chores such as packing, washing, and sweeping. A successful Spellcasting (6) test conjures the spirits, which work together carrying up to 40 pounds for the spell's duration.

Undead Struggle.name: Undead Struggle
Undead Struggle.description: Locks the caster and an undead target in a contest of raw willpower, neither able to act until one falls or the spell ends. Cast against the undead's Mystic Defense; each round the caster's Effect test contests the target's Willpower test, and the loser takes Mystic damage equal to the higher result, reduced by Mystic Armor.

Aspect of the Fog Ghost.name: Aspect of the Fog Ghost
Aspect of the Fog Ghost.description: Coalesces fog and fuses a spiteful fog spirit into a willing target, granting +3 to close combat Attack and Damage tests and +3 to Physical Defense. Cast against the target's Mystic Defense; the spirit urges attacks on the nearest foe each round, resistible with a Willpower test against Social Defense 12.
Aspect of the Fog Ghost.summary: +3 to close combat Attack and Damage tests, +3 to Physical Defense

Chilling Circle.name: Chilling Circle
Chilling Circle.description: Spins a glowing rune on the ground from which freezing mist rises in a 2-yard radius. Cast against the highest Mystic Defense within the area; all inside except the caster take Nethermancer Circle +4 damage each round and move at half their Movement Rate.

Death’s Head.name: Death’s Head
Death’s Head.description: Twists the caster's head into a skull smeared with gore that terrifies anyone he looks at. Cast against his own Mystic Defense; for the duration he may use the Frighten talent as a Simple action.

Night’s Edge.name: Night’s Edge
Night’s Edge.description: Coats a weapon with inky frost drawn from astral space. Cast against the target's Mystic Defense; the wielder adds a D4 Bonus Die to the weapon's Damage test, and anyone damaged suffers a -2 penalty to Mystic Defense until the end of the next round.

effects.summary: Adds Step 3/D4 cold damage to weapon/Physical and reduces target’s

Night’s Edge.summary: Adds Step 3/D4 cold damage to weapon/Physical and reduces target’s

Shadow’s Whisper.name: Shadow’s Whisper
Shadow’s Whisper.description: Ties the magician's hearing to a target's shadow, letting him hear anything the target says within 2 yards of one. Cast against the target's Mystic Defense; the target may make a Perception test against the Spellcasting result to realize he is being observed.

Shield Mist.name: Shield Mist
Shield Mist.description: Armors the caster in a shroud of mist that hardens to turn aside blows, granting a +4 bonus to Avoid Blow tests against close and ranged combat attacks. Cast against his own Mystic Defense; the mist neither hides him nor hinders his actions.

effects.summary: +4 to Avoid Blow tests while active.

Summon Fog Ghost.name: Summon Fog Ghost
Summon Fog Ghost.description: Coalesces fog and coaxes a maleficent spirit into it, conjuring a fog ghost that attacks the nearest character each round using the Effect Step for Attack and Damage tests until destroyed or the spell ends. Cast against the spirit's Mystic Defense.

Animate Skeleton.name: Animate Skeleton
Animate Skeleton.description: Sets the bones of the dead in motion, raising one skeleton within range per thread woven, up to the caster's Nethermancer Circle. A successful Spellcasting (10) test rouses the bones, and the skeletons obey mental commands within sight until the spell ends.

Death Trance.name: Death Trance
Death Trance.description: Places a willing or unconscious character in suspended animation, making them appear dead. Cast against the target's Mystic Defense or 6; while suspended they do not decay, their afflictions do not progress, and they cannot heal until the spell ends.

effects.summary: Puts the target into suspended animation

Death Trance.summary: Puts the target into suspended animation

Netherlight.name: Netherlight
Netherlight.description: Draws clean light from astral space into a fixed globe floating a yard overhead, illuminating a 10-yard radius. A successful Spellcasting (10) test brings the light forth; undead, Horrors, and Horror constructs seeking to enter must win a Willpower test against the Effect Step or remain outside.

Sculpt Darkness.name: Sculpt Darkness
Sculpt Darkness.description: Molds an existing shadow into any shape the caster desires. A successful Spellcasting (10) test shapes the darkness; those hidden within gain +5 to stealth-based Action tests and add +5 to the Difficulty to detect them, though a sculpted shadow hides only one character.

Translator Spirit.name: Translator Spirit
Translator Spirit.description: Summons a language spirit that merges with a willing target's head, granting +3 to Speak Language and Read and Write Language tests and comprehension of the dialects of languages he already knows. A successful Spellcasting (6) test binds the translator.

effects.summary: +3 to Speak Language and Read and Write Language tests

Translator Spirit.summary: +3 to Speak Language and Read and Write Language tests

Arrow of Night.name: Arrow of Night
Arrow of Night.description: Cloaks an arrow, bolt, sling stone, or blowpipe dart in a chilled sheath of midnight darkness. A successful Spellcasting (6) test adds +6 to the missile's Damage test, and anyone damaged by it takes a -2 penalty to Mystic Armor until the end of the next round.

effects.summary: +6 to the enchanted missile Damage test.

Arrow of Night.summary: +6 bonus to a missile Damage test and a -2 penalty to Mystic Armor

Aspect of the Bone Spirit.name: Aspect of the Bone Spirit
Aspect of the Bone Spirit.description: Draws a bone spirit from a Bone Circle within Spellcasting rank × 10 miles and yokes it to a willing target, who grows pale with prominent bones. A successful Spellcasting test against the target's Mystic Defense grants +4 to both Mystic Defense and Mystic Armor.

Aspect of the Cowardly Skulk.name: Aspect of the Cowardly Skulk
Aspect of the Cowardly Skulk.description: Smears a willing target with dripping shadow-stuff, binding a skulking spirit that merges with them and drops them into a squirrel-like crouch. A successful Spellcasting test against the target's Mystic Defense grants +4 to Perception tests for direct observation and to Action tests to escape detection. Any active threat makes the target flee, ending the spell.

effects.summary: Grants a target superior scouting abilities at a cost

Aspect of the Cowardly Skulk.summary: Grants a target superior scouting abilities at a cost

Fog of Fear.name: Fog of Fear
Fog of Fear.description: Conjures a cold, wispy gray fog into a fixed 4-yard-radius sphere. A successful Spellcasting (6) test allows the caster to use the Frighten talent against every target within the area as a single action.

Grave Message.name: Grave Message
Grave Message.description: Speaks a message of up to fifty words within a Bone Circle, cemetery, or place active with spirits. A successful Spellcasting (6) test carries the message to another such site, where it is delivered once to the Named character or any passerby matching the caster's description.

Pain.name: Pain
Pain.description: Racks the target with stabbing waves of crippling agony. A successful Spellcasting test against the target's Mystic Defense inflicts 3 temporary Wounds and halves the target's Movement Rate for the duration. Creatures that feel no pain are unaffected.

effects.summary: Cause the target 3 temporary Wounds and reduce movement

Pain.summary: Cause the target 3 temporary Wounds and reduce movement

Summon Bone Spirit.name: Summon Bone Spirit
Summon Bone Spirit.description: Calls a bone spirit out of a Bone Circle within Spellcasting rank × 10 miles, letting it roam beyond the circle briefly. A successful Spellcasting test against the spirit's Mystic Defense brings it before the caster, where it obeys commands while remaining within 10 yards.

Animate Spirit Object.name: Animate Spirit Object
Animate Spirit Object.description: Summons a spirit to inhabit and reshape an object up to a three-yard statue's size, giving it ambulatory capability. A successful Spellcasting (10) test summons a reasonably intelligent spirit that follows complex commands, though it vanishes if attacked and never fights.

Astral Whisper.name: Astral Whisper
Astral Whisper.description: Cups hands to the ears and listens for sounds made by spirits and Horrors in astral space. When the Spellcasting result beats the Mystic Defense of any astral being within 20 yards, the caster hears what that entity says.

Bone Dance.name: Bone Dance
Bone Dance.description: Yokes a bone spirit onto the target's bones and forces them to move against their will. After a successful Spellcasting test against the target's Mystic Defense, the spirit contests an Effect-step Willpower test each round; when it wins, the target is Harried, cannot move, and stumbles a random few yards.

Pattern Spike.name: Pattern Spike
Pattern Spike.description: Drives a spike of astral force into the target's Pattern, leaving a trailing thread to the caster. A successful Spellcasting test against the target's Mystic Defense deals Willpower+3 mystic damage, and the caster may apply a -2 penalty, as a Free action, to one test the target makes before the next round ends.
Pattern Spike.summary: WIL+3/Mystic and -2 to an Action test (see text)

Spirit Double.name: Spirit Double
Spirit Double.description: Summons a shaggy spirit double from a reflective surface, a lookalike of the caster. A successful Spellcasting (10) test produces a form with the spellcaster's Attributes but no skills or magic, acting as a decoy or unskilled assistant until any damage dismisses it.

effects.summary: Creates a spirit double of the spellcaster

Spirit Double.summary: Creates a spirit double of the spellcaster

Aspect of the Menacing Tyrant.name: Aspect of the Menacing Tyrant
Aspect of the Menacing Tyrant.description: Binds a spirit of terror to a willing target, stiffening their posture and sharpening their features with a cruel gleam in their eyes. On a successful Spellcasting test against the target's Mystic Defense, all gamemaster characters treat the target as Neutral, and the target gains +6 to intimidation and fear tests.

effects.summary: Grant target bonuses to social interaction at a cost

Aspect of the Menacing Tyrant.summary: Grant target bonuses to social interaction at a cost

Dark Spy.name: Dark Spy
Dark Spy.description: Borrows the senses of a nightflyer held under the caster's control after sunset. A successful Spellcasting test against the creature's Mystic Defense lets the caster perceive the world as the nightflyer does up to Spellcasting Rank miles away; while linked, the caster's own senses are numbed, leaving them Harried for Action tests other than Perception.

effects.summary: See and hear through a nightflyer’s senses

Dark Spy.summary: See and hear through a nightflyer’s senses

Evil Eye.name: Evil Eye
Evil Eye.description: Sets the caster's pupils to shimmering with flickering green flame. A successful Spellcasting test against the caster's own Mystic Defense lets the Frighten talent curse with the evil eye and grants an additional Success on every successful use of it.

extraThreads.label: Increase Effect (+1 additional Success to Frighten tests)

effects.summary: Increase Effect (+1 additional Success to Frighten tests)

Last Chance.name: Last Chance
Last Chance.description: Reaches a character who died within the last minute and pulls them back from the brink. A successful Spellcasting test against the target's Mystic Defense grants a Recovery test at +4—or a Step 4/D6 test if none remain—and the target lives only if their Current Damage drops below their Death Rating.

effects.summary: Grants +4 bonus Recovery test to a dead character

Last Chance.summary: Grants +4 bonus Recovery test to a dead character

Nightflyer’s Cloak.name: Nightflyer’s Cloak
Nightflyer’s Cloak.description: Draws an invisible cloak over the shoulders and reshapes the caster into a nightflyer of a designated kind. A successful Spellcasting test against the caster's own Mystic Defense grants the creature's abilities, including flight and keen senses, though the caster cannot speak or cast spells while transformed.

extraThreads.label: Increased Effect (+2 to Perception tests while in creature form)

effects.summary: Increased Effect (+2 to Perception tests while in creature form)

Viewpoint.name: Viewpoint
Viewpoint.description: Punctures astral space to open a one-way spy window up to a square yard through a wall or barrier no more than 2 yards thick. A successful Spellcasting (6) test lets the caster see through while the barrier stays intact; the result sets the difficulty for spotting the window.

Aspect of the Shadow Hunter.name: Aspect of the Shadow Hunter
Aspect of the Shadow Hunter.description: Tears a hunter spirit from nearby shadows and binds it to a willing target, a red-eyed figure that merges with them. A successful Spellcasting (6) test grants +4 to tests that locate a single designated quarry, +2 to Attack and Damage against them, and +2 to Physical and Mystic Defense.

Blood Servitor.name: Blood Servitor
Blood Servitor.description: Cuts a finger and splashes blood so that a small flying body coalesces for the caster's Orbiting Spy spirit, at the cost of 3 Blood Magic Damage for the duration. A successful Spellcasting (10) test creates the servitor, a linked creature whose senses the caster can borrow while commanding it verbally.

Fatal Food.name: Fatal Food
Fatal Food.description: Wastes a thread on each of three separate dishes so that their combined consumption triggers a lethal reaction. A successful Spellcasting (10) test poisons anyone who tastes even a bit of each, inflicting Effect-step poison damage as the mix takes effect.

Forget Hunger.name: Forget Hunger
Forget Hunger.description: Mimes refusing a plate and dulls the target's appetite with a wash of nausea. A successful Spellcasting test against the target's Mystic Defense keeps hunger at bay for the duration, though starving the body still takes its eventual toll and nourishment now turns the stomach.

Spirit Servant.name: Spirit Servant
Spirit Servant.description: Inscribes a personal glyph in a circle that must lie undisturbed overnight, then summons an ethereal humanoid servant. A successful Spellcasting (10) test conjures a quiet, intelligent assistant capable of speech and of carrying 50 pounds, though it will retreat rather than fight.

Summon Shadow Hunter.name: Summon Shadow Hunter
Summon Shadow Hunter.description: Calls a red-eyed hunter spirit out of nearby shadows after reaching into them. A successful Spellcasting (8) test summons a skilled track that hunts a single quarry at Step 8, using a Name, blood, or possession to focus its pursuit.

Aspect of the Cruel Physician.name: Aspect of the Cruel Physician
Aspect of the Cruel Physician.description: Binds a spirit of pain to a willing target, whose eyes glow faintly red as it merges. The bound character may operate on an adjacent willing character, who suffers a Wound and immediately makes a Recovery test at +6; the spell ends should the bound character suffer a Wound.

effects.summary: Grants Recovery tests for a price

Aspect of the Cruel Physician.summary: Grants Recovery tests for a price

Blind.name: Blind
Blind.description: The caster claws at their own eyes, and the target's eyes vanish, leaving empty sockets. While blinded, the target suffers a Full Darkness penalty to sight-based tests and each round may pass a Willpower test against the caster's Willpower Step to restore their eyes and end the spell.

extraThreads.label: Increase Effect (+2 to effective Willpower Step)

effects.summary: Increase Effect (+2 to effective Willpower Step)

Circle of Astral Protection.name: Circle of Astral Protection
Circle of Astral Protection.description: The caster paces out the circle's circumference, then tests against the highest Mystic Defense among characters within it. All allies inside the 8-yard radius gain +4 Mystic Armor for the duration.

Dust to Dust.name: Dust to Dust
Dust to Dust.description: A hard swallow sends destructive energy at a group of undead, tested against the highest Mystic Defense among them. A successful cast deals WIL + 8 Mystic damage — determined by the Effect test — to each of up to Spellcasting Rank targets, and undead reduced past their Death Rating crumble to dust.

extraThreads.label: Additional Target (+1 Target; additional target threads do not count toward the normal extra thread maximum)

effects.summary: Additional Target (+1 Target; additional target threads do not count toward the normal extra thread maximum)

Reverse Withering.name: Reverse Withering
Reverse Withering.description: Touching a withered limb and infusing it with energy from another plane reverses the Wither Limb spell. The limb is not fully restored — the target keeps a penalty to tests using it until the Wound behind the withering is healed.

Wither Limb.name: Wither Limb
Wither Limb.description: A pointed finger and a whispered word wither a limb: legs, arms, wings, or tails. The Effect test inflicts WIL + 6 Mystic damage, and if the target suffers a Wound the limb shrivels, making the target Harried in any round they use it — and halving movement or grip as appropriate.

Astral Seeking.name: Astral Seeking
Astral Seeking.description: This ritual summons a gaunt spirit sheathed in black that detaches the caster's astral form — costing a Wound — and leads it to a netherworld after a Spellcasting (10) test. Answers arrive as a suggestive vision, and the caster returns when the spell ends.

effects.summary: Summons a spirit guide to answer a question

Astral Seeking.summary: Summons a spirit guide to answer a question

Blood Lost.name: Blood Lost
Blood Lost.description: Wringing gestures worsen the target's injuries and impede healing. While the spell lasts, Wounds cannot be healed naturally, Damage healing suffers a penalty, and even mystical healing requires a Recovery test against the Effect step.

Cold Storage.name: Cold Storage
Cold Storage.description: Within an active bone circle, the caster salts and sprinkles goods before a Spellcasting (8) test stills their decay. Bodies and food stop rotting for the duration and can then be moved freely.

Creeping Dread.name: Creeping Dread
Creeping Dread.description: Whispered fears and a tug on the caster's shadow lengthen shadows unnaturally as dread settles over the area, brought on by a Spellcasting (10) test. Those within the 10-yard radius suffer -2 Social Defense, while tests to frighten, intimidate, or slip from detection gain +4.

Scythe Ward.name: Scythe Ward
Scythe Ward.description: Marking an area with personal glyphs sets a ward after a Spellcasting (15) test; any uninvited crossing conjures an astral scythe trailing cold mist. Those in the 4-yard radius take Mystic damage from the Effect test and suffer -4 to Action tests until sunrise, though a known key phrase briefly disarms it.

Whisper Through the Night.name: Whisper Through the Night
Whisper Through the Night.description: A whisper forces a summoned or free spirit to answer questions; each success on the Spellcasting test against its Mystic Defense permits one question, which the spirit must answer truthfully — though it may hedge with half-truths.

Astral Maw.name: Astral Maw
Astral Maw.description: Chewing noises summon a giant fanged mouth rimmed with writhing tentacles from astral space, once the caster beats their own Mystic Defense. While concentrating, it attacks a designated target each round with the Effect step against Physical Defense, dealing Nethermancer Circle + 10 damage.

Bone Shatter.name: Bone Shatter
Bone Shatter.description: Cracking sounds rattle out as the caster tests against the highest Mystic Defense among up to Spellcasting Rank targets. Each success grants an Effect test for WIL + 6 Mystic damage, and a Wound adds +5 to the victim's knockdown difficulty.

Debilitating Gloom.name: Debilitating Gloom
Debilitating Gloom.description: A bone-cold mist rises from rents of green glow in the earth and saps the life from a 6-yard area. All within have their movement halved and take a Wound each round they remain, which an hour of rest slowly heals.

Friendly Darkness.name: Friendly Darkness
Friendly Darkness.description: Darkness drawn from another dimension extinguishes all light in a 6-yard radius, worsening sight-based tests. The caster exempts up to their Spellcasting Rank characters from the penalty and grants them a +2 bonus to one chosen type of Action test.

Recovery.name: Recovery
Recovery.description: A touch boosts the target's life force; a successful Spellcasting test against their Mystic Defense grants a Recovery test with a +5 bonus that healing aids cannot improve. Targets with no Recovery tests available gain nothing.

Step Through Shadow.name: Step Through Shadow
Step Through Shadow.description: Standing against a shadow, the caster turns shadows into gates at the ends of an astral tunnel up to 100 yards long. A Spellcasting test against their own Mystic Defense opens the passage — which also lets astral entities slip into the physical world.

extraThreads.label: Increase Effect (+2 to Movement Rate) Increase Range (+10 yards) Seventh Circle

effects.summary: Increase Effect (+2 to Movement Rate) Increase Range (+10 yards) Seventh Circle

Bone Walker.name: Bone Walker
Bone Walker.description: This ritual, worked in a bone circle, joins a troll-sized pile of bones into an animated guardian after a Spellcasting (10) test. The walker takes orders by concentration or follows its last command, and is destroyed once it suffers its full tally of Wounds.

Grave Silence.name: Grave Silence
Grave Silence.description: A shattered crystal bead stills all sound within a 4-yard area after a Spellcasting (6) test. Speech and spells that require it become impossible, while sound-based talents take effect only if their result beats the spell's dispelling difficulty.

Netherwave.name: Netherwave
Netherwave.description: Spinning with arms wide, the caster releases an undulating wave of necrotic energy against the highest Mystic Defense in the area. Each target struck takes WIL + 4 Mystic damage from the Effect test and suffers -2 to their next Initiative test.

Nightmare of Foreboding.name: Nightmare of Foreboding
Nightmare of Foreboding.description: Thrown sand and soot seal the target into a routine of terrifying, helpless-making dreams. Each night a Willpower test determines how little rest they get, and failing Toughness tests each morning mounts cumulative penalties to Action and Initiative tests until a full night of genuine sleep.

Tears of the Scourge.name: Tears of the Scourge
Tears of the Scourge.description: Screaming, wailing Scourge spirits fill a 6-yard area, and those caught collapse weeping — incapacitated and Knocked Down. Each round they may compose themselves with a Willpower test against the Effect step, while harming the afflicted instead torments the caster.

Wall of Darkness.name: Wall of Darkness
Wall of Darkness.description: Arms outstretched and fists clenched raise a wall of ink-black darkness, screening all sight from both sides after a Spellcasting (6) test. Attacks and spells passing through are absorbed when their test result falls short of the casting result, and those that get through still take a penalty to the test result.

Aspect of the Casual Murderer.name: Aspect of the Casual Murderer
Aspect of the Casual Murderer.description: A spirit of murder merges with a willing target — summoned by a Spellcasting test against their Mystic Defense — its presence shown by lengthening nails that weep blood. The bound character gains +5 to close combat Attack and Damage tests against foes who are Blindsided, Knocked Down, or Surprised.

Astral Beacon.name: Astral Beacon
Astral Beacon.description: Leaping with arms flung high, the caster raises a bright flare in astral space around the target after a Spellcasting test against their Mystic Defense. The target is treated as having just cast a Seventh Circle spell with raw magic, facing all the usual Warping, Damage, and Horror-mark tests.

effects.summary: Creates a beacon in astral space

Astral Beacon.summary: Creates a beacon in astral space

Bone Pudding.name: Bone Pudding
Bone Pudding.description: After eating something messy, the caster turns the target's arm and leg bones to a pudding-like sludge, inflicting 3 Wounds without Damage Points. Movement drops to zero, leaving the victim only defensive and weight-free actions until the bones re-harden.

Constrict Heart.name: Constrict Heart
Constrict Heart.description: A grasping hand squeezes the target's heart in astral force, immobilizing them. While concentrating, the caster inflicts damage each round from the Effect test, and the target may end the spell with a Willpower test against the Effect step.

Foul Vapors.name: Foul Vapors
Foul Vapors.description: Holding their breath, the caster draws nauseating vapors from astral space into a 10-yard area, where they hang motionless and mere contact is enough to affect living and undead alike. Each round the Effect test deals WIL + 5 Mystic damage, leaving those struck Harried; the caster is unaffected.

Restrain Entity.name: Restrain Entity
Restrain Entity.description: A ring of red light edged with gold encircles an undead, Horror, Horror construct, or manifested spirit, holding it in place. The captive may attempt to break free each minute with a Willpower test against the Effect step, and any hostile action ends the spell.

Banquet of Dis.name: Banquet of Dis
Banquet of Dis.description: Rubbing their stomach and smacking their lips, the caster suppresses a craving of the target's choosing — eating, drinking, or sleeping. Each denied need costs a Recovery test not refreshed until the spell ends, and healing the target receives is reduced by 2 per need ignored.

Death’s Visitation.name: Death’s Visitation
Death’s Visitation.description: The spirit world obliges with a vision of the target's death, its method chosen by the caster, and the mesmerizing horror freezes the target in place while imposing -2 on Willpower-based tests. They shake it off — ending the spell — by succeeding at a Willpower test against the caster's Willpower Step.

Desiccate.name: Desiccate
Desiccate.description: A wringing gesture pulls moisture from the target — drying soaked belongings or stripping up to the Effect result in pounds from other goods. Against a living target the Effect test inflicts WIL + 5 Mystic damage and a -2 penalty to their next Action test.
Desiccate.summary: WIL+5/Mystic and -2 to next Action test

Pattern Ligature.name: Pattern Ligature
Pattern Ligature.description: Tearing motions rip a small gap through astral space, opening a path to a visible target. While the target stays within range, the caster may cast any non-Touch spell through the gap at them, until a free Willpower test against the dispel difficulty closes it.

effects.summary: Extends the range of spells to a specific target

Pattern Ligature.summary: Extends the range of spells to a specific target

Spirit Bolt.name: Spirit Bolt
Spirit Bolt.description: A beam of violet energy lances at a target visible in astral space, disrupting their pattern. The Effect test inflicts WIL + 8 Mystic damage, though only targets without physical form — such as spirits and dual-natured Horrors — can be struck.

Wit Friend.name: Wit Friend
Wit Friend.description: A knowledge spirit coalesces and merges with a willing target after a Spellcasting (6) test, granting a second chance at any failed Perception-based test outside combat. Resources spent on the first attempt are gone and must be spent anew on the retry.

effects.summary: Allows a second chance on some Perception-based tests.

Wit Friend.summary: Allows a second chance on some Perception-based tests.

Aspect of the Astral Savant.name: Aspect of the Astral Savant
Aspect of the Astral Savant.description: An insanity spirit merges with a willing target after a Spellcasting test against their Mystic Defense, their eyes darkening to black spheres lit by otherworldly flame. The target perceives astral space unfiltered, gaining +4 to Physical Defense and Astral Sight tests that cost no Strain, while each round of raw sensing deals damage like First Circle raw magic.

extraThreads.label: Increase Effect (+2 to Astral Sight tests)

effects.summary: Increase Effect (+2 to Astral Sight tests)
Grants unfettered perception into astral space

Aspect of the Astral Savant.summary: Grants unfettered perception into astral space

Horror Call.name: Horror Call
Horror Call.description: White and gold inscriptions draw a named Horror from astral space into a 4-yard protective circle. A Spellcasting test against its Mystic Defense calls it, and it remains until it breaks out with a Willpower or Dispel Magic test against the dispel difficulty, is released, or the spell ends.

Netherblade.name: Netherblade
Netherblade.description: A melee weapon darkens with a smoky gleam and can strike targets in astral space. During the spell it passes harmlessly through physical foes, so the wielder must perceive the astral target — typically through Astral Sight — to hit.

effects.summary: Allows a weapon to affect targets in astral space.

Netherblade.summary: Allows a weapon to affect targets in astral space.

Shadow Tether.name: Shadow Tether
Shadow Tether.description: Visible shadows are pinned to the ground, anchoring their owners in place; up to the caster's Spellcasting Rank of targets can be caught. Tethered targets are Harried, and breaking free each round demands a Strength test against the casting result.

effects.summary: Prevents targets from moving and are Harried

Shadow Tether.summary: Prevents targets from moving and are Harried

Spirit Portal.name: Spirit Portal
Spirit Portal.description: Within a bone circle, the caster punches a widening doorway into astral space. The caster controls who passes while in sight, resisting unwanted crossings with an Effect test against the being's Willpower test.

Wither Away.name: Wither Away
Wither Away.description: An uttered prophecy and a touch begin a slow wasting; the Effect test sets the pounds the target loses each month, reduced by natural Mystic Armor. The withering continues until the target dies or the spell ends, leaving the emaciated Harried and, worse, taking actual damage each month.

Armor of Bone.name: Armor of Bone
Armor of Bone.description: With a crack of knuckles, the willing target's bones grow through their skin to cinch their armor tight after a Spellcasting (10) test. The spell grants +2 Physical Armor and +2 to fear-related tests, though most onlookers react with open distaste.

Blood Boil.name: Blood Boil
Blood Boil.description: Gurgling noises set the target's blood to boiling, skin and veins rippling as steam rises from their pores. Each round a fresh Spellcasting test against Mystic Defense lets the Effect test inflict WIL + 5 Mystic damage, though this works only on living creatures with blood.

Damage Shift.name: Damage Shift
Damage Shift.description: Rattling their clothing and tapping their brow creates a pattern link between the caster and a victim. After a Damage test rolls against the caster, an Effect test transfers up to its result in damage to the victim — blunted by their Mystic Armor — before the link severs.

Gravelight.name: Gravelight
Gravelight.description: A foul chant raises a pale misty orb from the ground until it fills a 30-yard radius with eerie shadows after a Spellcasting (10) test. Summoned spirits and undead within the area gain +4 to Attack and Damage tests while the light lingers.

Lock the Astral Gates.name: Lock the Astral Gates
Lock the Astral Gates.description: Standing perfectly still with closed eyes, the caster thickens the veil over a 10-yard area, a dull boom and rasping chains echoing through both realms. Summoning, astral sensing, and passing between realms inside it demand extra successes and willpower, backed by an Astral Interference test with a +6 bonus.

Visions of Death.name: Visions of Death
Visions of Death.description: A touch shows the target death lurking around every corner, each circumstance vivid with their own demise. They are left disoriented at -4 to Action tests until a Willpower test against the Effect step — permitted each morning — lets the visions fade.

Astral Materialization.name: Astral Materialization
Astral Materialization.description: Yanks an astral-space entity into the physical world, where it appears cloaked in chill mist and luminous ichor; a Spellcasting test against its Mystic Defense succeeds, and the materialized creature is bound to stay and refrain from harming the caster unless attacked.

Dark Sword.name: Dark Sword
Dark Sword.description: Shadows condense around a personal amulet into a one-handed weapon of the caster's design; a Spellcasting (10) test forms it, and darkness radiating around the caster inflicts Full Darkness penalties while the blade strikes with Spellcasting and deals Mystic damage from the Effect test.

Draining Eye.name: Draining Eye
Draining Eye.description: A third eye crowned by a star-swirl pupil opens on the caster's brow after a Spellcasting (15) test; locking onto a living target, a Nethermancy test against their Mystic Defense drains life force, dropping their Action tests by 1 per success and lifting the caster's by the same.

Mystic Vessel.name: Mystic Vessel
Mystic Vessel.description: Ghostly wisps of magic traced onto a willing living target hide the caster's entire mystic essence within them; a Spellcasting (10) test succeeds, leaving the caster appearing mundane and unable to use any abilities while the vessel's Detection Difficulty comes from the Effect Step.

Silent Darkness.name: Silent Darkness
Silent Darkness.description: A pocket of magical darkness that also swallows all sound settles over the area; a Spellcasting test against the highest Mystic Defense within it (minimum 10) succeeds, silencing voice and sight so those inside suffer a -4 penalty to Action tests while the caster is unaffected.

Skin Shift.name: Skin Shift
Skin Shift.description: The caster's wrenching touch tears the victim's skin free, twisting it about their body; a Spellcasting test against the target's Mystic Defense succeeds, and the Effect test deals damage no armor reduces alongside an automatic Wound.

Twist Emotion.name: Twist Emotion
Twist Emotion.description: Rewrites the victim's feelings for a day, with each success on a Spellcasting test against their Mystic Defense allowing a deeper perversion of emotion, from softening anger to affection or twisting jealousy to euphoria; a successful Perception test against the caster's Willpower Step hints at the manipulation.

Void Wave.name: Void Wave
Void Wave.description: Darkness rolls out from the caster in a 6-yard-wide wave shot through with tortured spirits; one Spellcasting test is compared to each target it touches, the Effect test dealing Mystic damage once while all struck suffer -2 to Action and Initiative tests until the next round.

Breach the Astral Gates.name: Breach the Astral Gates
Breach the Astral Gates.description: Silvery glyphs sketch a gate the caster kicks down, flattening the divide between astral and physical realms across a 20-yard radius; a Spellcasting (20) test succeeds, making damage resist with the higher of Physical or Mystic Armor and realm-specific sight interchangeable.

Onion Blood.name: Onion Blood
Onion Blood.description: A Spellcasting test against the victim's Mystic Defense peels away skin and muscle in bloodied layers; the Effect test deals Mystic damage each round and adds a Wound, while onlookers who fail a Willpower test against the caster's Willpower Step are Harried.

Restless Death.name: Restless Death
Restless Death.description: Whispering the target's Name, the caster wrenches the spirit from a willing body, killing it briefly and sending both into an astral realm; after a Spellcasting (10) test the target returns at the end of the next round, healing damage from the Effect test but gaining a Pattern Wound.

Soul Trap.name: Soul Trap
Soul Trap.description: A Spellcasting (10) test made on a corpse dead no more than the caster's Circle in hours binds the deceased's essence to their body, stretching the window in which magic can still pull them back from final death.

Spirit Tempest.name: Spirit Tempest
Spirit Tempest.description: A vortex of green-eyed spirit shapes tears through everyone in a 6-yard radius, clawing at their patterns; a Spellcasting test against the highest Mystic Defense in the area (minimum 10) succeeds, the Effect test dealing Mystic damage each round while all but the caster are Harried.

Tap Horror Karma.name: Tap Horror Karma
Tap Horror Karma.description: The caster wrenches at the air, tearing Karma free from a Horror or Horror construct; a Spellcasting test against its Mystic Defense succeeds, stealing 1 Karma Point each round, cleansed of astral corruption, into the caster's own pool.

effects.summary: Like taking Karma from a Horror

Tap Horror Karma.summary: Like taking Karma from a Horror

Journey to Life.name: Journey to Life
Journey to Life.description: This ritual threads a tendril into astral space as a beacon guiding a dead character's essence home; a Spellcasting (20) test succeeds, the spirit's journey taking as many days as it was dead and setting its Current Damage one below its Death Rating.

effects.summary: Guides a dead character’s essence back to

Journey to Life.summary: Guides a dead character’s essence back to

Walking Dead.name: Walking Dead
Walking Dead.description: A ritual that anoints a Namegiver dead within the last Circle days and speaks them back to a shambling existence; a Spellcasting (10) test succeeds, and the zombie obeys the caster's mental commands within line of sight.

Crop Blight.name: Crop Blight
Crop Blight.description: Trampling the ground while weaving and crushing a torn-up plant, the caster blights the land; a Spellcasting (10) test succeeds and all plant life withers within the hour across a 1-mile radius, with nothing regrowing for a month.

Eclipse.name: Eclipse
Eclipse.description: A ritual disk of darkness rises off the caster to swallow the sun; a Spellcasting (10) test succeeds, casting a 1-mile radius into shadow for the duration.

Gateway.name: Gateway
Gateway.description: Green-spark pinwheels frame a rift linking two of the caster's bone circles; a Spellcasting (20) test opens a gateway, and travelers pass through a shielded astral tunnel at 10 miles per minute while the entrance lasts Rank rounds and the path an equal number of minutes.

effects.summary: Creates a path through astral space

Gateway.summary: Creates a path through astral space

Moon Shadow.name: Moon Shadow
Moon Shadow.description: Under moonlight the caster's silver dagger sketches the target in sand, stealing a pale twin shadow that glides away; a Spellcasting test against the target's Mystic Defense succeeds, letting the caster hear through it and, by stabbing it with silver, harm the target via the Effect test.

Call Forth the Army of Decay.name: Call Forth the Army of Decay
Call Forth the Army of Decay.description: Within a bone circle and fed by an hourly blood sacrifice, corpses in a 100-yard radius crawl from their graves; a Spellcasting (10) test succeeds, animating one undead group per 25 bodies under the caster's mental command.

Shadow Palace.name: Shadow Palace
Shadow Palace.description: Woven threads raise a doorway in the air that opens into an astral pocket furnished to the caster's taste; a Spellcasting (10) test succeeds, and guests rest free of the physical world before reappearing at the doorway when the spell ends.

Annihilate Pattern.name: Annihilate Pattern
Annihilate Pattern.description: Blood from the caster's own wounds seeps across a linked pattern item as this ritual rends the target's pattern apart; a Spellcasting test against the target's Mystic Defense succeeds and each round the Effect test deals damage plus a Wound; reaching the Death Rating leaves no healing or return possible.
